title: Desperate Housewives
description: The lives of a group of suburban women turn out to be full of secrets, intrigues, and unexpected darkly comic twists.

title: Sherlock
description: A modern take on the sharp-minded detective who, together with Dr. Watson, investigates complex crimes in London.

title: SKAM
description: A group of Norwegian high school students navigates friendship, identity, love, and social pressure, with each season told from one character’s perspective.

title: Lucifer
description: The Devil decides to take a break from Hell, moves to Los Angeles, opens a nightclub, and helps the police solve crimes.

title: Money Heist
description: A group of robbers led by the mysterious Professor carries out a meticulously planned heist on the Royal Mint of Spain.

title: Elite
description: Students at an exclusive private school face social inequality, secrets, and crimes that change their lives forever.

title: Suits
description: A brilliant but unlicensed lawyer starts working at a prestigious law firm while hiding his past.

title: Gossip Girl
description: A mysterious blogger exposes the secrets of wealthy and influential Manhattan teens, disrupting their lives and relationships.

title: How to Get Away with Murder
description: A brilliant law professor and her students become entangled in a complex murder case where everyone has something to hide.

title: Shameless
description: A large family struggles to survive as each member deals with poverty, their reckless father, and the chaos of everyday life.

title: Game of Thrones
description: Noble houses battle for power over the Seven Kingdoms while an ancient evil awakens beyond the Wall.
